premise_or_derivation: Requires compact-localized source support or an exterior decay theorem strong enough to make the side integral vanish.
notes: This is the safer asymptotic version for isolated bodies.

premise_or_derivation: Requires the channel-by-channel projected exchange zero not signed in 3756.
notes: This closes the mass/source charge, not every PPN residual.

premise_or_derivation: Requires the 3755 global-kappa/superselection premises or an explicit kappa evolution law.
notes: This turns the LLR/Gdot row into the first scoreable coupling row.

premise_or_derivation: All three premises must be parent-signed before any local-GR or Gdot claim is allowed.
